name: redis
description: In-memory data store for caching, session management, and real-time messaging

roleAssignments.note: Use Entra ID auth (access keys disabled) with managed identity

defaultConfig.note: Basic C0 for dev/test (~$16/month, 250MB). Standard C1 for production (~$50/month, 1GB, replication). Premium for VNet + clustering.

integration.authNote: Use Entra ID auth with access keys disabled. Requires redisConfiguration.aad-enabled = 'true' and Data Owner role assignment.

bicepWiring.roleAssignment: Use role 'Redis Cache Data Owner' (roleDefinitionId: '8dd8a07b-5d86-4a8e-a01c-5a7c90a69bdf') for full read/write. Use 'Redis Cache Data Contributor' for read + write without admin.

sdkInitPattern.python:
import redis.asyncio as aioredis
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
token = credential.get_token('https://redis.azure.com/.default')

client = aioredis.Redis(
    host=os.environ['AZURE_REDIS_HOST'],
    port=int(os.environ['AZURE_REDIS_PORT']),
    username=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'),
    password=token.token,
    ssl=True,
    decode_responses=True
)

healthCheck.description: PING command validates connectivity and auth
